checks: wrong credentials are reported and nothing is bound
join preview counts downloads, uploads and same-named documents without writing
connecting joins the remote workspace; the local file stays and the remote one arrives beside it
status chip and last-pass report reflect the completed sync
the password only crosses IPC for probe and bind; never stored by the webview
pause is persisted per binding and resume syncs again
a merge conflict copy from two devices editing one line is listed with both paths
resolving line by line writes the result and keeps the replaced body and the copy in the trash
the resolved body and the copy deletion are published on the next pass
a rolled-back remote pauses sync with an explanation and leaves files untouched
rejoining under a new device id resumes sync, publishes a new head and keeps every file
exit sync removes the binding after confirmation and keeps workspace files
scope: Production UI with deterministic IPC; real servers are covered by verify-sync-e2e.
